NATIONAL WATER SUPPLY AND DRAINAGE BOARD ACT, No. 02 OF 1974
Order under Section 92

BY virtue of the powers vested in me, under Section 92 of the National Water Supply and Drainage Board Act, No.02 of 1974,I, Lucky Jayawardena, the Acting Minister of City Planning, Water Supply, and Higher Education, do hereby approve theacquisition of immoveable property of three allotments of land described in the following Schedule, as it is required by thesaid board, for laying of piplelines and construction of access road from the south bank of the salinity barrier to Puhulyayaroad for providing water supply to Agunakolapelessa New Prison.

LUCKY JAYAWARDENA,Minister of City Planning,Acting Water Supply and Higher Education.Ministry of City Planning, Water Supply and Higher Education,No. 35, “Lakdiya Medura”,New Parliament Road,Pelawatta, Battaramulla,05th July, 2019.5/2/2/1480.SCHEDULE

Three allotment of land situated in the village of Pawalluvila in the Grama Niladhari Division No. 146, Puhulyayain the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Ambalanthota in Hambanthota District containing total extent of about 12 perchesbounded as follows :—
